name: Celebration

dates.note: Wikipedia files the community under 'Populated places established in 1994'; its text: 'In the early 1990s, the Disney Development Company (DDC) established the Celebration Company'; Cooper Robertson's Wikipedia list dates the 'Master Plan for Celebration, Florida for the Disney Development Company' 1997.
